lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's five over twenty-eight? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 5/28? Nope!

lines.text: Five boys and three girls stand in a random order.
lines.caption: 5 boys and 3 girls stand in a random order.

lines.text: What is the probability that no two girls stand next to each other?
lines.caption: What is the probability that no 2 girls stand next to each other?

lines.text: Line up the five boys first. That makes six gaps, counting both ends.
lines.caption: Line up the 5 boys first. That makes 6 gaps, counting both ends.

lines.text: Two girls in one gap would touch. So each gap gets at most one girl.
lines.caption: Two girls in one gap would touch. So each gap gets at most one girl.

lines.text: Pick three of the six gaps. That's twenty ways, out of fifty-six equally likely sets of spots.
lines.caption: Pick 3 of the 6 gaps. That's 20 ways, out of 56 equally likely sets of spots.

lines.text: Twenty over fifty-six is five over fourteen!
lines.caption: 20/56 is 5/14!

lines.text: Five over twenty-eight was the trap. It forgets an end gap.
lines.caption: 5/28 was the trap. It forgets an end gap.

lines.text: Did you get five over fourteen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 5/14? Tell me below!
